title: fields: a text-valued formula is drawn in monospace code font in the table cell and the form face, declared `returnType: 'text'` or not
body:
Filing gate ①: a user-visible defect, measured in a browser.
`reach:` the console, measured on objectstack-ai/hotcrm `2f3d898d` with `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0-next.0: the Leads list's Name column and the lead record's FULL NAME (`crm_lead.full_name`, a text formula) render a person's name as code.
Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat (`session_01P8mZuzuyZAHSrgQKmv6ASv`) from its dev's measurement on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2095 (report comment `6163809460`). ⛔ Not a claim.
Reader: objectui triage, then the lane that owns `packages/fields`.
Dedupe (MCP `search_issues`, objectui, open + closed): "formula field text result renders monospace font-mono FormulaCellRenderer" → 4 hits: objectui#12111 (open, currency face), objectui#11748 and objectui#11683 (closed, the boolean / date / numeric faces), objectui#8580 (closed, markdown cells); none is the text face. "formula returnType text code font name column monospace" → 0.

## What happens

- On Leads (`/_console/apps/app.objectstack.hotcrm/crm_lead`) the Name cell renders `span.text-gray-700.font-mono.text-sm`, computed `font-family` `ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, …`. The Company cell beside it is proportional (`-apple-system, "SF Pro Text", …`).
- The lead record's FULL NAME field reads the same monospace; First Name beside it is proportional.
- **Declaring the type changes nothing.** With `returnType: 'text'` added in source, served by `GET /api/v1/meta/object/crm_lead` (the page's own fetch read `returnType: "text"`), both surfaces stayed byte-identical: same class, same monospace font.
- Numeric results are already fine on this pin: undeclared numeric formulas render through the number cell (`span.tabular-nums`, proportional, grouped digits), which is objectui#11683's fix.

## Producer (read on objectui `origin/main` `065a1cf`)

- `packages/fields/src/index.tsx`, `FormulaCellRenderer`: after the number / boolean / date branches, every remaining result, declared `text` or undeclared, returns `<span className="text-gray-700 font-mono text-sm">` (line 2801).
- `packages/fields/src/widgets/FormulaField.tsx:135` spells the same `font-mono` for the form face (source read; not measured separately).
- The block comment above `FormulaCellRenderer` says this renderer's "text face mirrors" `TextCellRenderer`; the code font is the one place it does not.

## Fix direction (for the implementer to measure, ⛔ not a ruling)

- Draw the text face in the same font as `TextCellRenderer`, in both modules, and keep the two faces in step (`__tests__/formulaFaces.returnType-11748.test.tsx` already compares them per declared type).
- Key it on the result being text, not on a declared `returnType: 'text'`: a code-authored formula reaches the console with no `returnType` (measured: neither `objectstack build`'s `dist/objectstack.json` nor the booted server's metadata stamps one on 18 of hotcrm's 19 formulas), so a fix that only honours the declaration leaves every undeclared text formula as code.
- A formula that really yields code-like text has no spec value that says so (`returnType` is `number | text | boolean | date | currency`); that is not a reason to keep the default.

## Acceptance

A text-valued formula, declared or not, renders in the proportional text font in the table cell and in the form face, and the two faces agree.

Blocks objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2095 (the app waits for this fix rather than restyling; HotCRM AGENTS.md §4).
